JMAtv page (/#/jmatv) renders the two-layer stacked brand mark: with jmatv-logo-v2-frame.png present and a .jmatv-letters-mask div with inline mask-image style pointing at /assets/ui/jmatv-logo-v2-letters.png (verified via DOM inspection). critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (unrelated) eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings in src/components/LightningStage.js (line 126) and src/pages/BoomGardenPage.js (lines 587, 864). Not blocking; consider cleanup.

index.css correctly no longer contains a bare-root url('/assets/...') mask-image (which css-loader tries to resolve as a module). The switch to inline JS style with process.env.PUBLIC_URL is the right fix; if a CSS-only approach is ever wanted, use url('%PUBLIC_URL%/...') via a template or move file into src/ and import it.

rca of the issue: RCA: In index.css, .jmatv-letters-mask had `mask-image: url('/assets/ui/jmatv-logo-v2-letters.png')`. CRA's css-loader treats url() as a module import (webpack module resolution) unless the URL is external (http), a data URI, or specifically ignored. Absolute path '/assets/...' points to CRA's public/ folder at runtime but css-loader attempts to resolve it against src/ at build time -> Module Not Found. FIX: Moved the mask-image declaration out of index.css and onto the element via inline JS style in JMAtvHomePage.js using `url(${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/assets/ui/jmatv-logo-v2-letters.png)`. Inline styles are not processed by css-loader so no module resolution is attempted. Verified: webpack now compiles with 0 errors; asset returns 200; DOM element receives the correct mask-image URL.
